text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You see, I'm currently on the hunt for a
new trick
to dazzle the audience with.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Oho? Then allow me to be of assistance!
I just
happen to have a new serum I've
been meaning
to—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, Tachyon. What did I say
about
experimenting on others?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I would appreciate your help, though. Your research is very intriguing to me, after all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Fine, have it your way. But what
is it you
want from me, then?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well... I know! Can you make flowers
sparkle like
lights?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I want to see those glistening flowers
rain down
from the sky, leaving the
audience stunned and
overjoyed!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
If it's flowers you want, I recently
acquired some
rafflesia for my genetics
research.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps I could install some lights into
their
centers and drop them on the
crowd from the
rafters.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
U-ummm... That certainly would be
stunning, but
in a much more... pungent
way.
